progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ek4 and dwells most on C in Razavi, Forud, Hazin. The line peaks at F5 (693.6 Hz) at 2:20.8. It closes on the tonic (Bb4 → Bb4 → C5 → G4 → C5 → G4).
